Name: Pink and White Furniture Plus
Author: Ballshorse
Description:
[b][size=6]Pink & White Furniture +
[/size][/b](The "+" is for the random stuff like Miku and Teto)


[size=4]This mod started as a personal project just to add some furniture I wanted to my own farm, but I thought it'd be fun to share!
[/size]
There are many different types of furniture and decor to choose from if you like the aesthetic I've gone for, as well as a few of my favourite albums to hang on the walls of your house. Many of these are recolours of Ape-made items to create a brighter and cuter farmhouse (in my opinion at least).

[size=4]Please check out the entire tilesheet in the images above to check out exactly what you're getting :)[/size]

[size=4]Thank you and I hope you enjoy decorating and if you have anything you want added in, let me know and I'll try to make it :)[/size]

[size=3]I also used the mod Cute Valley Pink whilst decorating, Which gave me the kitchen/crib retextures and the wallpaper and recoloured china hutch TV and fishtanks[/size]

(I do not own any of the album art or the dawg, I have just made them Stardew Valleyed)

Thank you to my wonderful partner for all their help on this mod <3
